facts: PCBA SKU 320110032 maps to MPN 1125R-SMT-4P and multipack SKU 114020164.
The guide explicitly recommends Seeed's GitHub Eagle/KiCad connector libraries.
The general placement advice keeps the connector inside the board outline and recommends at least 0.5 mm copper/pad clearance from board edges. This is not an exact connector-specific PCB-edge datum.

interfaces.implementation_status: selected_for_correction_by_parent_and_connector_agent; no native write performed by this review
interfaces.verification: The current native footprint was rotated and translated in memory only. All pad bounding boxes remained on the 80x150-mm PCB. Native DRC and adjacent-component/cable-access checks belong to integration.

confirmed_defects: The current rectangular F.Fab body is centred at the existing pad-frame origin, while the official CAD implies an approximately +0.985-mm longitudinal body offset in that frame.
Simply rotating the existing native anchor [18.0,145.45] to B.Cu 180 degrees puts both mechanical solder lands out to Y=150.635, beyond the bottom PCB edge.

cad_alignment.transform: Rotate the official CAD 180 degrees, then translate longitudinally into the existing Leshy2 pad frame.
cad_alignment.precision_boundary: The 0.00192-mm discrepancy reflects the independently rounded CAD/production land coordinates; these derived decimal places are not a manufacturer dimensional-tolerance guarantee.

mouth_nominally_flush.qualification: Derived geometry, but less than the general Seeed 0.5-mm copper-edge advice.

remaining_implementation_requirements: Correct the source footprint body datum without moving its already reconciled electrical pads or changing MPN.

Recheck and enlarge the front courtyard as needed: existing +5.55 outline is only 0.015 mm beyond corrected nominal body front +5.535. A possible front +5.85 with rear -5.55 gives courtyard-centre offset +0.15 and proposed world centre [18.0,144.45] for anchor [18.0,144.30]. This courtyard is a proposed implementation, not a manufacturer rule.
Regenerate the controlled library/native instance through the normal dependency chain and rerun mechanical/electrical/DRC checks.
Verify complete mating-cable clearance and actual received-part fit separately; no connector-specific PCB-edge prescription is inferred from the drawing.

manufacturer_actuation.ordering_code: SC = Vertical, Gullwing; SA is a different right-angle gullwing termination option and is not the selected MPN
manufacturer_actuation.actuator_extension_direction: Normal to the mounting PCB, above the package top; not a side-projecting edge actuator
manufacturer_actuation.slide_travel_direction: Parallel to the package long axis on its top face
current_metadata_errors: devices.json kind calls this exact MPN right_angle_smt, contrary to SC ordering code and the page-5 drawing.
devices.json dimensions_mm [8.5,3.5,3.6] does not reserve the approximately 5.5-mm total assembled height including the actuator.

current_native_pose_observed.access_implication: The top actuator projects toward the inner sandwich. In-plane rotation cannot turn this vertical actuator into a side-exiting slider. Accessibility and vertical clearance are not established by placing the body near the left PCB edge.

manufacturer_recommended_land_layout_bod.view: Component-side top view consistent with the exact-part drawing: terminals 1 and 3 below the body, common terminal 2 above it
manufacturer_recommended_land_layout_bod.derivation: Page 5 prints 1-mm pad width, 8-mm total outer axial span, 3-mm gap between opposite pad ends, and 2.5-mm horizontal pitch. Equal recommended pad lengths are (8-3)/2=2.5 mm; centres are at +/-2.75 mm. Terminal 2 is shown on the opposite side, not in a common row with 1 and 3.

findings: Confirmed assembly defect: current common pad 2 is on the wrong package side; all three current pads are incorrectly in one row.
Recommended land width/length also differ from the current 0.8x3.2-mm lands; the current footprint description incorrectly claims these are page-5 recommended SMT lands.
The logical common contact remains manufacturer terminal 2; no logical-function change is proposed. Correct physical landing, native integration and retest remain required.
A same-MPN placement/access solution or another explicitly reviewed implementation is still needed; this evidence review does not select a replacement or authorize production.
